messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident INC-1729 fired for service 'api-prod' — high redis-miss rate + downstream Postgres connection spike. Alert rule: redis.sentinel.failover + pg.connections > 90%.

sasha: acked. I'm on it, pulling logs and sentinel status.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty notification: INC-1729 acknowledged by sasha. Escalation paused.

oncall-bot: auto-escalation timer paused (ack by sasha).

lee: quick note — UI is seeing 5xx for a subset of users, correlated to cache misses. Could be failover not fully completed.

alex: getting redis sentinel output now, one master reported down then new master promoted ~02:01 UTC, but a bunch of clients still hitting old IP.

maria: pg prometheus shows connections jumping from 40 -> 230 over 90s, pgbouncer showing pools saturated and errors like 'server_lost'.

sasha: here are the redis sentinel lines I see:
```
172.31.12.45:6379 is master -> subjectively down
sdown master myredis 172.31.12.45 6379 @ sentinel-3
+promoted-slave slave 172.31.12.48:6379
+failover-end
```

sasha: but service discovery didn't update in time, cluster service IP still routing to 172.31.12.45. App retries -> cache miss -> DB connection storm.

lee: can we temporarily redirect service ip to new node or update kube endpoints? Who has rights to bump the k8s svc?

alex: I can patch the k8s endpoints now, but we might need infra approval to SSH to nodes if it's external LB. Trying 'kubectl get endpoints -n prod redis-service -o yaml'...

maria: logs from app show retry flood, snippet:
```
2026-02-18T02:03:10Z ERROR redis: connect ECONNREFUSED 172.31.12.45:6379 retrying (attempt 6)
2026-02-18T02:03:10Z WARN db: pool wait > 2000ms acquiring connection
2026-02-18T02:03:11Z ERROR pg: could not connect to server: too many connections
```

oncall-bot: pgbouncer alerts firing: pgbouncer.pool_wait_seconds > 5s (prod).

sasha: immediate mitigation proposal:
- patch redis service endpoints to point to 172.31.12.48 (new master)
- enable app rate-limiter throttle for background workers (reduce retry loops)
- scale down consumer deployment by 50% to reduce db connection demand
- add temporary pgbouncer max_client increase if safe

lee: I can do the consumer scale down (kubectl scale deploy/consumers -n prod --replicas=2). Doing it now.

alex: patching endpoints now (kubectl patch endpoints prod redis-service --patch '{"subsets":[{"addresses":[{"ip":"172.31.12.48"}],"ports":[{"port":6379}]}]}'). Applying...

sasha: thanks. Maria, can you throttle workers? We have feature-flag to pause retries.

maria: pausing retry flag now: feature-flag set redis-retries=false for prod. Confirmed.

lee: scaling consumers down 10 -> 2. kube reports scaling started.

alex: endpoints patched, DNS svc now returning 172.31.12.48. Health checks look good.

sasha: monitoring — redis misses dropping, pg connections trending down. pgbouncer queue length decreasing.

maria: Postgres connections back to ~60, errors dropping. Gradual recovery.

pagerduty-bot: INC-1729 status changed to 'mitigated' by sasha.

sasha: leaving short postmortem notes here: cause = redis sentinel failover + service-discovery lag caused app clients to flood DB with retries. Pg pool exhaustion + pgbouncer queueing produced errors.

lee: timeline estimate: failover started 02:01 UTC, retries/connection ramp 02:02-02:06, mitigation actions 02:06-02:10, recovery visible by 02:12. Total customer impact window ~10-12 minutes noticeable, up to 30m for tail retries.

alex: impact: intermittent 500s for ~3% of requests; two high-volume customers saw rate-limiting and reported errors. No data corruption.

maria: follow-ups before close:
- add sentinel-to-service integration test for endpoint switch timing
- add alert that correlates redis failover + sudden application db connection spike (composite)
- add circuit-breaker on app side to avoid immediate retry storms
- evaluate pgbouncer config for emergency scaling

oncall-bot: INC-1729 will be auto-closed in 72 hours unless reopened.

sasha: handing off to alex for detailed postmortem. tagging alex.

alex: taking postmortem, will produce draft by EOD. adding action items and timeline. ack handoff.

maria: adding customer-impact ticket to support queue and pinging two affected accounts.

sasha: thanks team. marking incident resolved in-channel. :white_check_mark:

lee: removing temporary throttles and scaling consumers back up after monitor is green.

alex: final note: pls treat as reminder to test sentinel->svc propagation on canary first.

pagerduty-bot: INC-1729 closed by alex at 02:36 UTC on 2026-02-18.
